senses.gloss: m. (dimin. of עֶרֶס, עַרְסָא) cradle, hammock for watchmen in gardens.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 1:8">Targ. Is. I, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 24:20">XXIV, 20</cite> (h. <he>מלונה</he>).—

<cite ref="Eruvin 25b:1">Erub. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>דעבידא כי אר׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אור׳</he>; Rashi <he>ארזי׳</he>; Tosaf. <he>ערס׳</he>) the roof of the shed has the shape of a cradle, i. e both sides slanting towards the centre.
